verdict.rationale: The axis applies because CRA runs digital services, including EFILE system-to-system transmission, so issuing scoped credentials to software is a fair question. The evidence shows no way to issue them. EFILE uses a single EFILE number and password per filer (cra-docs-17). 'Authorize access to online information' and the Represent a Client portal (cra-docs-10, cra-docs-18) delegate account access to human representatives, not scoped API credentials for an AI agent. The probe also finds no agent-oriented docs index on canada.ca (cra-probe-2).
